description: Set or unset a space's task defaults (what a task created in the space gets) and its own display and storage overrides, by the key the space file uses: defaultTags, defaultContexts, defaultProjects, defaultPriority, defaultStatus, defaultOnCompletion, defaultUseTaskNotes, defaultAdditionalProperties, defaultReminders, the due/scheduled/start date type, offset, specific date and time, inheritStorageSettings, defaultFile, defaultTaskHeader, useDailyNoteAsDefault, archiveFile, the task-file folders, display settings, defaultEventCalendarId/Title and defaultNewNoteFolder. Normalized as the app's space editor saves. Validated and written like set_space; dry_run:true writes nothing.

set.description:
Task defaults to set, by the key the space file uses, values as the
file holds them: defaultTags, defaultContexts, defaultProjects
(arrays), defaultPriority, defaultStatus, defaultOnCompletion,
defaultUseTaskNotes, defaultAdditionalProperties (object),
defaultReminders (array of reminder objects), defaultDueDateType /
defaultScheduledDateType / defaultStartDateType (none, today,
todayPlusDays, specificDate) with their DaysOffset, SpecificDate and
Time ({hour, minute}) fields, inheritStorageSettings, defaultFile,
defaultTaskHeader, useDailyNoteAsDefault, archiveFile,
taskNotesDefaultFolder, taskNotesArchiveFolder,
useGlobalDisplaySettings, customDisplaySettings,
defaultEventCalendarId, defaultEventCalendarTitle,
defaultNewNoteFolder. A null value unsets the key.

unset.description: Keys to unset, so the app's own default applies.

name: set_space_defaults
